costume.name: Disco Phantom
costume.description: A shimmering hooded cape over an ivory flared jumpsuit, with silver gloves and platform boots.
costume.alt: Pearl silver sequined hooded cape over an ivory satin flared jumpsuit, silver gloves, and silver platform boots

pieces.name: Silver hooded cape
pieces.styleNotes: Create a flowing silver hooded outer layer. The reference has pearl-silver sequins and a silver lining. Lower tiers substitute metallic or holographic fabric. The sequin option is a sleeved kimono rather than a circular cape.

matches.reason: Silver holographic Lycra spandex outside with black holographic lining, full hood and throat ties. About four pounds. This 50-inch version costs $145.20; the 60-inch version costs more and is excluded. No sequins. Made to order; merchant states dispatch within five days.

Silver variant only. Shimmering metallic hooded cape; smooth holographic surface rather than pearl sequins. Cape only; white clothes and shoes in the photo are not included. Ships Monday-Friday from Chicago; no delivery date verified.

52-inch hooded silver sequin kimono, $274 in all three listed sizes. Mesh foundation, unlined, with long sleeves: closer silver sequin texture but a robe silhouette rather than a circular lined cape. Hood is included in this product. Other clothes and boots are excluded. Handmade; dispatch lead time is not stated on the product page.

pieces.name: Ivory flared jumpsuit
queries: ivory satin wide leg bridal jumpsuit
pieces.styleNotes: An ivory one-piece with a fitted waist and broad legs. The reference uses satin, a low wrap neckline and dramatic bell bottoms. Options vary in fabric, neckline and leg shape.

matches.reason: House of Wu style 48052 in Ivory / 14 / Charmeuse Satin only. Surplice sweetheart bodice, shoulder straps, wide-leg pants and back zipper. Wider straight legs rather than extreme bell-bottom flares. Discontinued; this is the sole current variant, despite the description mentioning a historical 0-30 range. Dispatch lead time is not stated.

Ivory flared catsuit in 77% polyester and 23% spandex. High zip neckline and long sleeves; matte stretch activewear rather than a low-neck satin jumpsuit. Ivory variants all list $119 and available. Shoes and accessories are excluded.

Bridal ivory heavy satin, strapless sweetheart bodice, internal cups and boning, waistband, pleated wide legs and pockets. The neckline and leg shape differ from the wrap-front bell-bottom reference. Only US0-US14 had positive inventory quantities in the primary page data; US16/US18 permit ordering with zero inventory and are excluded. Jumpsuit only.

pieces.name: Silver gloves
pieces.styleNotes: Add fitted silver gloves with full fingers. The generated gloves are long and glittery; these products range from shorter metallic costume gloves to satin and mirror-finish opera gloves.

matches.reason: Silver stretch satin gloves, 22.44 inches / 57 cm long. The merchant does not publish a numeric hand size. Soft satin sheen rather than a metallic or sequined finish. Gloves only; bridal clothing in the photo is excluded. Product page explicitly says in stock.

One pair of silver metallic full-finger gloves. Product page does not publish a numeric size or exact length. Photo shows a forearm-length cuff rather than the longer opera proportions in the reference. Page structured data explicitly lists InStock at $10.99.

Selected Opera-Length pair is 19.6 inches, $70. Silver synthetic patent leather, unlined, minimal stretch. Merchant fit limits: palm perimeter up to 7.5 inches and upper arm under 11 inches. Mirror finish rather than glitter. Other lengths have different prices and are excluded.

pieces.name: Silver platform ankle boots
pieces.styleNotes: Silver ankle boots with a raised front platform. These genuine Pleaser products use 7-inch stiletto heels, unlike the broader heels in the image. Pick a height the wearer can manage.

matches.reason: Silver rhinestone-covered lace-up ankle boots, chrome platforms and inside zips. 7-inch heels, 2 3/4-inch platforms. Only women's US 5, 10 and 12 are available at $80.95; other sizes are sold out. Stiletto heel rather than a broad heel. Clearance item; final sale, no returns or exchanges.

Silver Chrome lace-up sequin ankle boots with inside zips, 7-inch heels and 2 3/4-inch chrome platforms. Women's US sizes as sold by Pleaser. Stiletto heel and shiny chrome bottom differ from the chunky glitter platform in the image. Clearance item; final sale, no returns or exchanges.

Silver open-toe and open-heel ankle boots with diamond-cut rhinestones, inside zips and back lacing. 7-inch stiletto heels and 2 3/4-inch chrome platforms. Women's US 6-10 are available; size 5 is sold out. Open ends and slim heels differ from the closed chunky boots in the image.

pieces.name: Optional silver waist belt
queries: silver crystal bridal ribbon sash belt
pieces.styleNotes: An optional reflective waist accent. The illustration shows a broad silver jeweled belt; the written guide also permits a silver ribbon belt. These options use silver stones on ivory satin ribbons.

matches.reason: Selected Ivory Ribbon version costs $68.99 and includes the silver crystal applique attached to 1.5-inch satin ribbon. Applique is 34.5 inches long, 1.5 inches at widest point; ribbon totals 108 inches. Floral crystal pattern rather than the image's large round buckle. The cheaper $58.99 applique-only version is excluded.

Selected Ivory ribbon with silver rhinestone ornaments. Polyester/rhinestone sash; 180 cm / 70.86-inch ribbon, 4 x 8 cm / 1.57 x 3.15-inch applique. The photos show decorative hanging end ornaments rather than an all-around jeweled belt or a plain silver ribbon. Ships from a USA warehouse; dispatch timing is not stated.

Selected Ivory Ribbon version is $98.99 with a silver crystal applique attached to satin ribbon. Applique is 23.2 x 2 inches; ribbon is 1.5 inches wide and 98.5 inches long. Ties for fit. Broad floral crystal decoration rather than a circular buckle; ribbon is ivory rather than metallic silver. Applique-only price is excluded.
